title: Do Households Adapt? Repeated Hurricane Exposure and the Stockpiling of Essential Goods
venue: Journal of Agricultural and Applied Economics
abstract: Understanding how households adapt to hurricanes is crucial as these hazards grow increasingly frequent and severe. This paper investigates the influence of past hurricane exposure on future household preparedness, specifically in stockpiling bottled water. Using four years of scanner data on bottled water purchases in the Southeastern United States, we apply a difference-in-differences event study framework to assess how repeated hurricane experiences shape purchasing behavior. Our findings reveal that households exposed to warnings—rather than direct landfalls—do not proactively prepare for future hurricane seasons, suggesting limited learning from prior warnings.
abstract_zh: 随着飓风日益频繁且日趋严重，理解家庭如何适应飓风变得至关重要。本文考察过去的飓风暴露经历如何影响家庭未来的防范准备，具体以囤积瓶装水为例。利用美国东南部四年的瓶装水购买扫描数据，我们采用双重差分事件研究框架，评估反复的飓风经历如何塑造购买行为。我们的研究发现，经历过预警而非直接登陆的家庭，并不会为未来的飓风季节主动做好准备，这表明他们从先前的预警中学到的东西有限。

title: Peer Effects in Voluntary Environmental Programs: An Application to Urban Water Quality
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

title: The Effect of Urban Climate Shifts on Land Values in the Chesapeake Bay Area
abstract: This study develops a micro‐level Ricardian model to assess how long‐run climate patterns affect agricultural land values across the urban–rural gradient in the Chesapeake Bay Watershed. Using an 8‐km gridded dataset that combines farmland prices, high‐resolution climate data, and urban land cover, the analysis shows that seasonal temperature and precipitation affect land values nonlinearly, and urbanization significantly moderates the effects of precipitation. A climate simulation suggests heterogeneous impacts across urban grids. Our findings highlight the critical role of urban land cover in shaping climate adaptation strategies, offering new insights into how transitional urban‐agricultural regions respond to climate stress. These results provide actionable guidance for policymakers seeking to enhance agricultural resilience in the face of continued urban expansion.
abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一个微观层面的李嘉图模型，以评估长期气候格局如何影响切萨皮克湾流域城乡梯度上的农业用地价值。我们使用一个8公里网格数据集，该数据集整合了农田价格、高分辨率气候数据和城市土地覆盖信息。分析表明，季节性气温和降水对土地价值的影响是非线性的，而城市化显著调节了降水的影响。气候模拟显示，不同城市网格受到的影响存在异质性。我们的发现凸显了城市土地覆盖在塑造气候适应策略中的关键作用，并为理解过渡性城乡农业地区如何应对气候压力提供了新的启示。这些结果为决策者提供了可操作的指导，帮助他们在城市持续扩张的背景下增强农业韧性。

title: Equilibrium Sorting Models
The Role of Flood Risk Characterization in Evaluating Property Market Impacts
Wildfire Risk and Home Prices: The Case of California Building Codes
abstract: The severity and intensity of wildfires have increased in the western U.S. in recent decades. At the same time there has been an expansion of people and housing into wildland areas increasing vulnerability and risk. Since the early 1990s California has mandated the usage of strict building codes for homes built in high-hazard areas of the state. This paper exploits the timing and location of these policies and their interaction with home vintages to estimate how increased wildfire defenses impacts home prices. Using sales data from 2013-2020 in an event study difference-in-difference model of home vintages, we estimate that treated homes - those built after the codes went into effect - sell for 1.4%-2.5% more than homes built before the policies were enacted. Combining our estimates with home prices and estimates of costs to retrofit homes in a benefit cost analysis reveals that premiums are roughly equal to the cost of meeting a basic set of wildfire fortifications. These results have direct policy relevance as they support efforts by policymakers considering the enactment of similar policies in other states.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，美国西部野火的严重程度和强度有所上升。与此同时，人口和住房不断向荒野地区扩张，从而增加了脆弱性和风险。自20世纪90年代初以来，加利福尼亚州对位于高风险地区的住宅强制执行严格的建筑规范。本文利用这些政策的实施时间和地点，及其与住宅建造年代之间的相互作用，估计增强野火防御能力如何影响房价。利用2013至2020年的销售数据，在住宅建造年代的事件研究双重差分模型中，我们估计，受政策处理的住宅（即规范生效后建造的住宅）的售价比政策颁布前建造的住宅高出1.4%至2.5%。将我们的估计结果与房价数据以及房屋改造成本估计相结合，进行成本效益分析后发现，溢价大致等于满足一套基本野火防护措施的成本。这些结果具有直接的政策意义，因为它们支持其他州的政策制定者考虑实施类似政策的努力。

title: Impacts of Water-Related Building Moratoria on California's Housing Crisis
abstract: California is facing a housing affordability crisis, which has been partially blamed on building moratoria enacted to address the state’s severe water shortages. This study uses data on the enactment of moratoria in California from 2010 to 2018 to examine their impacts on new housing supply and prices. We find that the short-term impact of the moratoria on housing supply is small, but the effect grows over time and becomes more significant in later years, especially for locally mandated moratoria. We do not, however, find that these supply shocks have had an impact on housing prices.
abstract_zh: 加利福尼亚州正面临住房负担危机，而这一危机部分被归咎于为应对该州严重的水资源短缺而实施的建设禁令。本研究利用2010至2018年加州建设禁令的实施数据，考察其对新住房供给和价格的影响。我们发现，建设禁令对住房供给的短期影响较小，但该影响会随时间增长，并在之后的年份变得更加显著，对于地方强制实施的禁令尤其如此。然而，我们并未发现这些供给冲击对房价产生了影响。

title: Urbanizing Agriculture, Additionality, and the Adoption of Agricultural Conservation Practices
abstract: Additionality is crucial to the success of programs aimed at promoting agricultural conservation practices. While its existence is established, it is important to understand the factors contributing to heterogeneity within the estimates. We explore urbanization as a novel pathway for that heterogeneity. Our analysis reveals reductions in additionality and higher voluntary adoption rates for more urban farms. These findings hold significant policy implications as they suggest that the relative targeting of funds to more rural areas may yield greater additionality. The final allocation would depend on a full analysis of the benefits and costs across the urban continuum.
abstract_zh: 增量性（additionality）对于旨在促进农业保护措施的计划能否成功至关重要。虽然增量性的存在已得到证实，但理解导致估计结果异质性的因素仍然很重要。我们探讨了城市化这一新的途径所带来的异质性。我们的分析表明，城市化程度越高的农场，增量性越低，而自愿采用率越高。这些发现具有重要的政策含义，因为它们表明，将资金相对更多地瞄准农村地区，可能会产生更大的增量效应。最终的资金分配则取决于对整个城乡连续统一体上的成本和收益所作的全面分析。

title: Scarcity by Design: How Water Constraints Impact Household Sorting and Welfare in the West
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

title: Carbon Sequestration Losses in Shale Gas Development: Evidence and Policy
Housing Density Amplification of Wildfire Ignition Risk Across the Western U.S.
The Impact of Water Scarcity on Housing Development: New Evidence from an Integrated Hydrological-Legal Metric
The Interactive Effect of Forested Riparian Buffers and Stream Water Quality on Recreation Demand

The Distributional Impact of FEMA's Community Rating System
The Effect of Natural Disasters and Extreme Weather on Household Location Choice and Economic Welfare
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Natural disasters have increased in the United States in recent decades. At the same time, there has been a shift in population away from the states in the Northeast and Midwest to areas in the Sun Belt, many of which face increased risks from natural disasters. Spatial equilibrium theory predicts that households trade off risk for income in making location decisions. This study estimates a spatial equilibrium model of household location choice to understand these trade-offs. The results show that households require as much as 0.40% of annual household income to endure an additional disaster over the course of a decade. They also show that these values differ substantially depending on household skill level with higher-skill, higher-income households willing to pay three times more in annual income to avoid an additional natural disaster. These results have important implications for policymakers thinking about climate change adaptation and environmental justice.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，美国的自然灾害日益增多。与此同时，人口从东北部和中西部各州向阳光地带（Sun Belt）地区转移，而其中许多地区面临着日益增加的自然灾害风险。空间均衡理论预测，家庭在做出区位决策时，会以风险换取收入。本研究构建了一个家庭区位选择的空间均衡模型，以理解这些权衡。结果表明，家庭为承受十年期间多出一次的灾害，需要相当于其年收入最高0.40%的补偿。结果还表明，这些数值因家庭技能水平的不同而存在显著差异：技能较高、收入较高的家庭愿意为避免额外一次自然灾害而支付的年收入高出三倍。这些结果对于考虑气候变化适应和环境正义问题的政策制定者具有重要意义。

title: Learning by Viewing? Social Learning, Regulatory Disclosure, and Firm Productivity in Shale Gas
abstract: In many industries firms can learn about new technologies from other adopters; mandatory disclosure regulations represent an understudied channel for this type of social learning. We study an environmentally-focused law in the shale gas industry to examine firm claims that disclosure requirements expose valuable trade secrets. Our research design takes advantage of a unique regulatory history that allows us to observe complete information on chemical inputs prior to disclosure, along with the timing of information availability for thousands of wells after disclosure takes effect. We find that firms' chemical choices following disclosure converge in a manner consistent with inter-firm imitation and that this leads to more productive wells for firms that carefully choose whom to copy -but also a decline in innovation among the most productive firms, whose innovations are those most often copied by other firms. Our results suggest there is a long-run welfare trade-off between the potential benefits of information diffusion and transparency, and the potential costs of reduced innovation.
abstract_zh: 在许多行业中，企业可以从其他采用者那里学习新技术；强制性信息披露法规是这类社会学习的一个研究不足的渠道。我们以页岩气行业一项以环境为重点的法律为研究对象，以检验企业关于披露要求会暴露有价值商业机密的主张。我们的研究设计利用了一段独特的监管历程，使我们能够在披露前观察到化学投入品的完整信息，并在披露生效后观察到数千口井的信息可得时间。我们发现，披露后企业的化学品选择呈现趋同，这与企业间相互模仿的做法相一致；这一做法使那些谨慎选择模仿对象的企业所开采的井更具生产力，但也导致了生产率最高的企业创新减少，因为这些企业的创新恰恰是其他企业最常模仿的对象。我们的结果表明，信息扩散与透明度所带来的潜在收益与创新减少的潜在成本之间存在长期福利权衡。

title: The Impacts of Agricultural Land Markets, Climate, and Weather on Urban Development
Potential Benefits of Remapping the Special Flood Hazard Area: Evidence from the U.S. Housing Market
abstract: A typical U.S. homebuyer's understanding of whether a property faces flood risk is based on whether the property is located inside the National Flood Insurance Program's (NFIP) Special Flood Hazard Area (SFHA). The SFHA boundary, however, may bias homebuyers’ perceptions of flood risk relative to unobserved true risk because the SFHA is an incomplete, and sometimes inaccurate, representation of flood hazards. Using a national dataset of property transactions, flood hazard data from the First Street Foundation, state-level measures of flood disclosure laws, and a spatially restricted triple-difference design, we distinguish capitalization effects of policy-driven (SFHA) versus quasi-objective (First Street) indicators of flood hazard. We identify these effects by assessing thousands of local spatial interactions between property SFHA designations, measures of quasi-objective flood hazard, and being in a state that mandates flood history disclosures. Being inside the SFHA generates a risk discount, but the signal is muted relative to underlying hazard exposure. Further, the SFHA signal can result in inefficient discounts for properties erroneously mapped in the SFHA. Disclosure requirements about flood history accentuate price effects for hazardous properties and result in more adequate risk internalization. In the absence of disclosures, however, we find either no or a weak risk signal for houses outside the SFHA that face flood hazard. Our results support calls for FEMA to update SFHA boundaries to include all houses that may experience flooding. Further, our results support policy reforms considered by FEMA to require flood-related disclosures from sellers to improve the market's ability to internalize flood risk.
abstract_zh: 美国典型的购房者判断某一房产是否面临洪水风险，通常基于该房产是否位于国家洪水保险计划（NFIP）的特别洪水灾害区（SFHA）之内。然而，SFHA边界可能会使购房者对洪水风险的感知偏离未被观测到的真实风险，因为SFHA只是对洪水灾害的一种不完整、有时甚至不准确的刻画。我们利用全国性的房产交易数据、First Street Foundation提供的洪水灾害数据、州一级的洪水信息披露法律指标，以及空间受限的三重差分设计，区分了政策驱动（SFHA）指标与准客观（First Street）洪水灾害指标所产生的资本化效应。我们通过评估房产的SFHA划定、准客观洪水灾害指标以及所在州是否强制要求披露洪水历史之间，数以千计的局部空间交互作用，来识别这些效应。位于SFHA之内会产生风险折价，但相对于潜在的灾害暴露，这一信号被削弱了。此外，对于被错误划入SFHA的房产，SFHA信号可能导致低效的折价。洪水历史披露要求会放大危险房产的价格效应，并使风险内化更加充分。然而，在没有披露要求的情况下，我们发现，对于位于SFHA之外但面临洪水威胁的房屋，风险信号要么不存在，要么很弱。我们的研究结果支持联邦紧急事务管理局（FEMA）更新SFHA边界，将所有可能遭受洪水的房屋纳入其中的呼吁。此外，我们的结果也支持FEMA所考虑的政策改革，即要求卖方披露与洪水相关的信息，以提高市场内化洪水风险的能力。

title: Housing Wealth, Food Spending, and Diet Quality: Evidence from Panel Data
Financial Literacy and Academic Outcomes
The Effectiveness of Taxes in Decreasing Candy Purchases
The Impact of Water Access on Short-Term Migration in Rural India
venue: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
abstract: Migration is an important risk-reduction strategy for households in developing countries. In this paper, we examine the impact of irrigation and its interaction with rainfall on short-term migration decisions in India. Our results show that migration responds to costs, and that deep fossil-water wells, which provide a constant source of water, eliminate any benefit of short-term migration. Our results also demonstrate that electricity availability lowers the likelihood of short-term migration even in areas where groundwater is significantly reduced. This suggests that regions with access to electricity can adapt and shift to new technologies that facilitate additional groundwater extraction.
abstract_zh: 迁移是发展中国家家庭的一种重要风险降低策略。本文考察灌溉及其与降雨的相互作用对印度短期迁移决策的影响。我们的结果表明，迁移会对成本作出反应，而能够提供持续水源的深层化石水井，消除了短期迁移的任何益处。我们的结果还表明，即使在地下水已显著减少的地区，电力供应也会降低短期迁移的可能性。这表明，拥有电力供应的地区能够适应并转向新的技术，从而促进额外的地下水开采。

title: Unconventional Energy, Taxation, and Interstate Welfare: An Analysis of Pennsylvania's Severance Tax Policy
Confronting Price Endogeneity in a Duration Model of Residential Subdivision Development
Not My Problem: Growth Spillovers from Uncoordinated Land Use Policy
abstract: Land use policy is administered at the local level in the U.S. However, many of the benefits and costs have broader spatial impacts. Thus, a lack of coordination across local jurisdictions may lead to unintended spillovers. Using historical data from the Baltimore, Maryland metro, we examine the impact that an extensive zoning policy change in Baltimore County had on new housing supply in surrounding counties. Defining treatment and control locations in surrounding counties based on their adjacency to Baltimore County, we find that the change in zoning policy led to an increase in housing supply of 42%-97% in adjacent counties. In both spatial and temporal falsification tests, we fail to find evidence of a spillover effect suggesting that the increased development was likely the result of spillovers from uncoordinated policy.
abstract_zh: 在美国，土地利用政策由地方层面管理。然而，许多收益与成本具有更广泛的空间影响。因此，地方司法辖区之间缺乏协调，可能会导致意想不到的外溢效应。利用马里兰州巴尔的摩都会区的历史数据，我们考察了巴尔的摩县一项大范围分区政策变化对周边各县新住房供给的影响。根据周边各县与巴尔的摩县的毗邻关系来界定处理组和对照组，我们发现，分区政策的变化使毗邻各县的住房供给增加了42%至97%。在空间和时间的证伪检验中，我们均未发现存在外溢效应的证据，这表明增加的开发很可能是不协调政策外溢的结果。

title: Spatial Heterogeneity, Accessibility, and Zoning: An Empirical Examination of Leapfrog Development
Invisible Water, Visible Impact: Groundwater Use and Indian Agriculture under Climate Change
abstract: India is one of the world's largest food producers, making the sustainability of its agricultural system of global significance. Groundwater irrigation underpins India's agriculture, currently boosting crop production by enough to feed 170 million people. Groundwater overexploitation has led to drastic declines in groundwater levels, threatening to push this vital resource out of reach for millions of small-scale farmers who are the backbone of India's food security. Historically, losing access to groundwater has decreased agricultural production and increased poverty. We take a multidisciplinary approach to assess climate change challenges facing India's agricultural system, and to assess the effectiveness of large-scale water infrastructure projects designed to meet these challenges. We find that even in areas that experience climate change induced precipitation increases, expansion of irrigated agriculture will require increasing amounts of unsustainable groundwater. The large proposed national river linking project has limited capacity to alleviate groundwater stress. Thus, without intervention, poverty and food insecurity in rural India is likely to worsen.
abstract_zh: 印度是世界上最大的粮食生产国之一，因此其农业体系的可持续性具有全球意义。地下水灌溉是印度农业的基础，目前它使作物产量提高，足以养活1.7亿人。地下水的过度开采已导致地下水位急剧下降，威胁着使这一至关重要的资源对数百万小农户而言变得遥不可及，而这些小农户正是印度粮食安全的支柱。从历史上看，失去地下水使用权既降低了农业产量，也加剧了贫困。我们采用多学科方法，评估气候变化对印度农业体系构成的挑战，并评估旨在应对这些挑战的大型水利基础设施项目的有效性。我们发现，即使在因气候变化而降水增加的地区，灌溉农业的扩张也将需要越来越多的、不可持续的地下水。拟议中的国家河流联网工程在缓解地下水压力方面能力有限。因此，若不加干预，印度农村地区的贫困和粮食不安全状况很可能会恶化。

title: Unconventional Shale Gas Development, Risk Perceptions, and Averting Behavior: Evidence from Bottled Water Purchases
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Advances in technology have made extraction of natural gas from deep shale formations economically viable. While unconventional shale gas development is seen as an economic benefit, concerns have been raised about the environmental and health risks associated with the extraction process. We combine GIS data on unconventional shale gas development in Pennsylvania and Ohio with household data on bottled water purchases to assess the impact that perceived risks to drinking water from unconventional shale development have had on household well-being using a triple difference treatment effects design. In our preferred triple difference models with time-varying treatment effects, we find per-household averting expenditure in 2010 ranges from 10.74 in our full sample specification to $15.64 when omitting urban counties more likely to contain public water supplies. Converting the sample-average averting expenditure of $10.74 to an annual expenditure for the entire impacted population implies an averting expenditure in Pennsylvania shale counties exceeding $19 million for the year 2010.
abstract_zh: 技术进步使得从深层页岩地层中开采天然气在经济上具有可行性。尽管非常规页岩气开发被视为一种经济利益，但人们也对开采过程中可能带来的环境和健康风险表示担忧。我们将宾夕法尼亚州和俄亥俄州非常规页岩气开发的GIS数据，与家庭瓶装水购买数据相结合，采用三重差分处理效应设计，评估非常规页岩开发对饮用水的感知风险给家庭福利带来的影响。在我们偏好的、具有时变处理效应的三重差分模型中，我们发现2010年每户家庭的规避支出，在完整样本设定下为10.74美元，而在剔除更可能拥有公共供水系统的城市县之后则高达15.64美元。将样本平均规避支出10.74美元换算为整个受影响人口的年度支出，意味着2010年宾夕法尼亚州页岩县的规避支出超过1900万美元。

title: Resident versus Non-Resident Employment Impacts Associated with Marcellus Shale Development
abstract: There is much debate surrounding the employment effect of shale gas development, especially as it relates to extraction counties. Anecdotal evidence suggests that many jobs are filled by non-resident workers. We examine the impact that shale gas development has had on local employment in Pennsylvania. Using data that links workers to their personal residences we find that Marcellus activity has had a positive, albeit modest, impact on job growth. We also find that the impact is 50 percent lower using data with only county residents suggesting that traditional employment data may overestimate the employment impacts on residents from shale development.
abstract_zh: 关于页岩气开发的就业效应，存在大量争论，尤其是与开采县相关的就业效应。轶事证据表明，许多工作岗位由非本地居民担任。我们考察了页岩气开发对宾夕法尼亚州当地就业的影响。利用将工人与其居住地相连接的数据，我们发现，马塞勒斯（Marcellus）页岩的开采活动对就业增长有正面影响，尽管幅度不大。我们还发现，若仅使用县内居民的数据，这一影响要低50%，这表明传统就业数据可能高估了页岩开发对当地居民的就业影响。

title: Time is Money: An Empirical Examination of the Effects of Regulatory Delay on Residential Subdivision Development
An Assessment of Empirical Methods for Modeling Land Use
venue: The Oxford Handbook of Land Economics
abstract: This chapter provides a targeted review and assessment of current empirical methods most commonly used in economics to model spatially explicit land use and land use change. Empirical models are broadly defined as those that use data on land use and the underlying demand and supply processes to specify model parameters in some way. Four main types of modeling methods are considered: reduced-form econometric, structural econometric, spatial equilibrium simulation, and agent-based simulation. Key strengths and weaknesses of each method are discussed, and the applicability of each method for answering various research questions, including policy scenarios, is illustrated with a few recent examples from the literature. The chapter concludes with a discussion of potential complementarities among these various approaches and several critical research gaps.
abstract_zh: 本章对经济学中最常用于建模具有明确空间特征的土地利用及其变化的实证方法，进行了有针对性的回顾与评估。实证模型被广义地定义为那些利用土地利用数据以及潜在的需求和供给过程，以某种方式设定模型参数的模型。本章考察了四类主要的建模方法：简约式计量经济学、结构式计量经济学、空间均衡模拟和基于主体的模拟。讨论了每种方法的主要优势与局限，并结合文献中的若干近期例子，说明每种方法在回答各类研究问题（包括政策情景分析）时的适用性。本章最后讨论了这些不同方法之间潜在的互补性，并提出了若干关键的研究空白。

title: Geographically and Temporally Weighted Likelihood Regression: Exploring the Spatiotemporal Determinants of Land Use Change
abstract: Urban areas possess complex spatial configurations. These patterns are produced by cumulative changes in land use and land cover as human and natural environments are influenced by markets forces, policy, and changes in the natural landscape. To understand the mechanisms underlying these complex patterns, it is important to develop models that can capture the complexity of the underlying economic process. This includes spatiotemporal variation in the variables as well as spatiotemporal heterogeneity or non-stationarity in the model. The objective of this paper is to build on previous work in spatial nonparametric modeling and propose a spatiotemporal technique for nonlinear panel data models. Using a series of Monte Carlo experiments, we demonstrate how extending a geographically weighted likelihood regression (GWLR) model to account for temporal heterogeneity can improve the performance of the model when heterogeneity exists in the spatial and temporal dimension. We also show how the technique can be used in modeling real world land use changes by applying our proposed technique to a panel of historical subdivision development from an urbanizing county in the Baltimore/Towson Metropolitan Statistical Area (MSA). Our results demonstrate that the method provides better performance than a standard parametric model. We also demonstrate how the spatiotemporal marginal effects from the model can be used to conduct policy analysis at multiple spatial and temporal scales, which is not possible using the standard global parameter estimates. Our proposed technique is simple to execute and can be implemented using any statistical software package.
abstract_zh: 城市地区具有复杂的空间格局。这些格局是由土地利用和土地覆盖的累积变化形成的，人类环境与自然环境受市场力量、政策以及自然景观变化的影响。为理解这些复杂格局背后的机制，有必要建立能够刻画潜在经济过程复杂性的模型。这包括变量的时空变化，以及模型中的时空异质性或非平稳性。本文旨在以既有的空间非参数建模研究为基础，提出一种适用于非线性面板数据模型的时空技术。通过一系列蒙特卡洛实验，我们展示了将地理加权似然回归（GWLR）模型扩展到考虑时间异质性后，在空间和时间两个维度都存在异质性时，可以提高模型的表现。我们还展示了该技术如何用于刻画现实世界的土地利用变化：将所提出的技术应用于巴尔的摩/陶森大都会统计区（MSA）一个城市化县的历史分区开发面板数据。结果表明，该方法的表现优于标准参数模型。我们还展示了如何利用模型得到的时空边际效应，在多个空间和时间尺度上进行政策分析，而这是使用标准全局参数估计无法做到的。我们提出的技术易于执行，可以使用任何统计软件包实现。

title: How Do Land Use Policies Influence Fragmentation? An Econometric Model of Land Development with Spatial Simulation
